meta.name: Commander Karan Saxena
meta.description:
As ISI-aided terror looms over the nation, RAW agent Karan Saxena must race against the clock to avert the attacks. But conspirators lurk in every shadow!

Rated U/A 16+ · Returning Series · First aired 8 Jul 2024 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Keylight · Network: Disney+ Hotstar

Complete series. On your server: S1 20/20

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Namak Ka Paani
videos.overview: As the dead body of a RAW agent washes ashore in Mumbai, Commander Karan Saxena takes charge. Nearby, something sinister brews as ISI agent Javed activates the sleeper cells.

videos.title: Talaash
videos.overview: ACP Rachana Mhatre must assist Karan as the team probes the presence of ISI agent Javed in Mumbai. A bigger threat looms with the news of a missing fisherman!

videos.title: Tere Sheher Mein!
videos.overview: A message from ISI agent Javed spurs Karan and the team into action. Getting their hands on a voice recording, Rachana and Karan uncover a shocking intel.

videos.title: Sheh Aur Maat
videos.overview: Flashbacks reveal Colonel Nasir’s deep-seated vendetta against India. Ready for a fightback, Karan and Rachana scour the city to defuse the impending attack.

videos.title: Kaun Hai Gaddaar?
videos.overview: A disturbing scene unfolds as Rachana and Karan find the hideout of sleeper cells. While Nasir sets an alternate plan in motion, Karan suspects a possible mole in the force.

videos.title: Haryana Mein Kya Hai?
videos.overview: With the force hot on his trail, Nasir flies to Haryana to execute his alternate plan. Back in Mumbai, Rachana tracks down the assailant who attacked RAW agent Sameer.

videos.title: Khet, Hookah, Aur Khat
videos.overview: With the help of his informant, Karan mobilises his network in Haryana to track down Nasir. Meanwhile, Rachana plans a covert move to find Javed.

videos.title: Mayajaal
videos.overview: Karan leads a covert mission to ambush Nasir but faces a major setback! With pressure mounting, Rachana launches a manhunt to find Javed.

videos.title: Dagabaaz
videos.overview: Karan starts connecting the dots to find the mole in the police force. Wrestling with a personal issue, Rachana closes in on the traitor. And she makes a choice!

videos.title: Ab Hoga Palatvaar!
videos.overview: The mole within the police force is identified! Tension heightens as Nasir narrates his plan on a call with Karan. With rising threats, the team braces for a fightback.

videos.title: Ek Saanp, Ek Sher
videos.overview: New intel about an ISI-hired assassin comes to light as Karan interrogates the mole, Inspector Amar. Meanwhile, constable Patil comes dangerously close to Nasir.

videos.title: Ranneeti
videos.overview: The tragic death of constable Patil lifts the lid on a hideout! Karan and the team prepare to strike the hiding foes but get caught in a deadly crossfire.

videos.title: Plan B
videos.overview: The deadly assassin Alexei springs into action, targeting Karan and the team. Solidifying an alternate plan, Karan readies to pounce back!

videos.title: Veergati
videos.overview: On the verge of a risky mission, Karan reflects on his journey as the commander. While the RAW team gains the upper hand, Nasir forges an alternate plan - doomsday!

videos.title: Kaun Apna, Kaun Paraya
videos.overview: The notes from Alexei lead Karan to Nasir’s secret hideout. But his plan to counterattack takes a dangerous turn as Nasir’s covert ally steps out of the shadows.

videos.title: Woh Amar Hai!
videos.overview: Tension heightens as the protestors in Haryana lead a search party to find Sher Singh. Meanwhile, a journalist tries to unveil the mystery around Karan’s death.

videos.title: Tohfa
videos.overview: Rachana’s arrest sparks chaos! Flashbacks reveal the making of a master plan. A new intel on Nasir’s secret ally stirs doubts about loyalty and treason within the force.

videos.title: Deshdrohi
videos.overview: A new danger looms as Nasir puts his ultimate pawn ACP Vinay Awasthi into action. While a deadly explosive is being readied, Karan and Rachana must race against the time.

videos.title: Tick, Tick...Boom!
videos.overview: Pressure mounts as the protestors brace for a confrontation with Karan. Vying for the upper hand, Nasir and Javed set the Black Day plan in motion.

videos.title: Taandav!
videos.overview: Karan is faced with impossible odds as Nasir and his allies are all set for the final strike. Amid the pandemonium, the forces must retaliate to bring down the enemies.
